title: View from the ship's porthole of a fiery planet and boxes being loaded

tellings.quote: there was something like a fiery well like a planet giving off heat. And from there they were taking out some kind of cylinders or maybe not cylinders, more like boxes. They were loading those into the ship.

plain: In 1997, Kiran Ilum Xenov, whom the show presents as the president of a Russian republic, says he was taken aboard an alien craft and looked out of its porthole. He tells Michels he saw "something like a fiery well, like a planet giving off heat," and that cylinders, or more like boxes, were being taken out of it and loaded onto the ship.
